units.per_call_usd: USD billed by fal per request to the router
units.input_usd_per_mtok: USD per 1,000,000 prompt tokens, upstream list rate
units.output_usd_per_mtok: USD per 1,000,000 completion tokens, upstream list rate
units.long_prompt: Upstream token rates that replace the row's own once a prompt exceeds over_input_tokens (OpenRouter pricing.overrides, whose min_prompt_tokens is over_input_tokens + 1)

provenance.per_call_usd: fal's own any-llm endpoint doc, fetched 2026-10-27: '$0.001 per requests', and 'Premium models are charged at 10x the rate of standard models' followed by the verbatim premium list. Materialized per row so no multiplier arithmetic lives in code.
provenance.token_rates: OpenRouter's public model catalogue (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models), fetched 2026-10-27. any-llm is 'powered by OpenRouter' and shares its model-id namespace, so these are the upstream rates fal resells. They are a floor on what a reseller can charge, never fal's own quoted per-token price -- fal publishes none.
